description: Instrument and tip decision, with no recipe change. In untimed side scripts, run the unchanged E090 code (48b13a7) and the unchanged E095 code (0503e38) through the benchmark's own trial code on seeds 3-26: 24 seeds each, one fresh process per config so the cuDNN picks are resampled. Do not edit benchmark/. Log per-seed accuracy, per-seed final-weight checksums, and the cuDNN conv kernel names per (layer, shape) from the profiler in build and the first steps; this is the free by-product for H4.5.1. For the scored row, rerun E090 unchanged; a non-bit-identical result adds a third distinct tip sample. Store both 24-seed per-seed vectors as the paired baselines for every later off-seed A/B on seeds 3-26.
